task_title: speclang stop crashes the serving process with uncaught ENOENT on daemon.pid
task_criteria: stop shuts down cleanly and tolerates a missing/stale pid file | proof: start --port 39124, curl dashboard 200, ./bin/speclang stop, assert the start process exits 0 and its output contains no ENOENT trace; plus a unit test for pid-file-absent | failure_condition: the start process exits non-zero or prints Error: ENOENT

items.criterion: stop shuts down cleanly and tolerates a missing/stale pid file | proof: start --port 39124, curl dashboard 200, ./bin/speclang stop, assert the start process exits 0 and its output contains no ENOENT trace; plus a unit test for pid-file-absent | failure_condition: the start process exits non-zero or prints Error: ENOENT
items.detail: Reproduced the exact AC in /home/kara/worktrees/SpecLang-DF-SPECLANG-6: `node bin/speclang start --port 39124 -d $SB` printed '✅ SpecLang Daemon Started'; `curl -s -o /dev/null -w %{http_code} http://localhost:39124/` -> HTTP=200; `node bin/speclang stop -d $SB` -> '✅ Daemon stopped', stop_exit=0; `wait $SPID` -> START_EXIT=0; `grep -c ENOENT /tmp/df6start.log` -> 0 and `grep -n Error` -> no match (exit 1); pid file removed; second stop -> 'Daemon not running', exit 0. Race path also verified: SIGTERM + external `rm daemon.pid` before the handler unlinks -> START_EXIT=0, ENOENT count 0. Fix sites: bin/speclang:24-41 (readDaemonPid returns null on ENOENT, removeDaemonPidFile ignores ENOENT) used by stop at bin/speclang:260-278 and daemon stop at 358-374; specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/index.ts:56-88 (compiled identically at dist/src/daemon/index.js:66-88) guards the serving process's own unlink and adds a `shuttingDown` guard. Pre-fix code (git show HEAD~1:bin/speclang) had unguarded `fs.unlinkSync(pidFile)` in both places. Unit test for pid-file-absent: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/daemon/pid-file-enoent.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 8 passed (8)', including 'stop with no pid file is a clean no-op (exit 0)' and the spawn-based 'exits 0 with no ENOENT trace when `stop` wins the pid-file unlink race' (not skipped — dist/src/daemon/index.js exists).

items.criterion: The serving process's own SIGTERM shutdown path tolerates the pid file already being gone (no uncaught ENOENT, exit 0) — the actual crash site
items.detail: specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/index.ts:56-88: `let shuttingDown` guard plus `try { fs.unlinkSync(pidFile) } catch (err) { if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') throw err }` inside a finally, then process.exit(0). Compiled output dist/src/daemon/index.js:66-88 matches. Live: `kill -TERM $SPID; rm -f $SB/.speclang/daemon.pid; wait $SPID` -> START_EXIT=0, 'ENOENT count: 0'.

items.criterion: The CLI stop path is idempotent/re-runnable: second stop and stale/empty/garbage pid file exit 0 with no ENOENT/ERR_INVALID_ARG
items.detail: bin/speclang:260-278 and 358-374: readDaemonPid (ENOENT -> null, non-integer/<=0 -> null) then removeDaemonPidFile (ENOENT ignored). Live second stop -> 'Daemon not running', exit 0. Unit tests 'stopping twice is idempotent', 'an empty pid file is stale state, not a NaN kill', 'a garbage pid file is stale state, not a NaN kill', 'a stale pid for a dead process is removed with exit 0' all pass in the 8/8 vitest run.

items.criterion: The fix is reachable from the shipped entrypoint (package.json bin -> ./bin/speclang) and the compiled dist/src/daemon/index.js used by `start` carries the guarded unlink
items.detail: package.json bin = {"speclang":"./bin/speclang"}; bin/speclang:70 requires ../dist/src/daemon/index.js, and dist/src/daemon/index.js:66-88 contains the guarded unlink (grep for 'shuttingDown' hits lines 68/70/72). End-to-end run through that entrypoint produced HTTP=200 and START_EXIT=0.

items.criterion: Non-ENOENT failures are still surfaced (readDaemonPid rethrows non-ENOENT; removeDaemonPidFile rethrows non-ENOENT) rather than silently swallowed
items.detail: bin/speclang:27-28 `if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return null; throw err;` and bin/speclang:38-40 `if (err.code !== 'ENOENT') throw err;`. Verified live: pid file chmod 000 -> `node bin/speclang stop -d $SB` printed 'Error: EACCES: permission denied, open .../daemon.pid' at readDaemonPid (bin/speclang:27) and exited 1 — the error is not swallowed.

items.criterion: The new unit test actually exercises the serving-process shutdown path (not skipped) and passes
items.detail: tests/daemon/pid-file-enoent.test.ts:161 uses describe.skipIf(!distBuilt); dist/src/daemon/index.js exists in this worktree, so the block ran. `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/daemon/pid-file-enoent.test.ts` -> 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 8 passed (8)' (8 = 7 CLI tests + the spawn-based serving-process test).
